verdict.rationale: Scribe is a SaaS speech-to-text API, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms that ElevenLabs documents an official MCP server in its GitHub repo, but the pack gives no detail on which tools it exposes or how an agent connects. Missing for 10: confirmation that Scribe transcription is exposed as MCP tools, documented setup and connection steps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
